value.name: Miles invites Rex to explain troubles
value.description: Miles adopts a sympathetic, counselor-like posture and invites Rex to tell him what is wrong.
evidence: MILES Now Rex.
MILES -- Tell me your troubles.
Miles gives an encouraging, rueful smile in return.

value.name: Rex complains about his wife
value.description: Rex says his wife has him in a difficult position and frames her as the obstacle to his desired outcome.
evidence: REX Jeez. Where do I start?
REX ...Well, my wife has me between a rock and a hard place.

value.name: Miles reframes wife as obstacle
value.description: Miles responds that a wife's job is to create difficulty, signaling his cynical, strategic approach.
evidence: MILES That's her job. You have to respect that.

value.name: Rex describes passionate marriage
value.description: Rex recalls that he and Marylin were once intensely attracted to each other physically.
evidence: REX When I first met Marylin -- Well, we were crazy about each other.
REX Not emotionally, of course. We just couldn't keep our hands off each other.

value.name: Miles implies desire fades over time
value.description: Miles dryly suggests that passion naturally cools with time, continuing the divorce-law banter.
evidence: MILES Time marches on. Ardor cools.

value.name: Rex insists Marylin remains attractive
value.description: Rex clarifies that the marriage did not cool because Marylin is still very sexy and desirable.
evidence: REX No. Not exactly. It didn't exactly cool.
Marylin is a knock-out. And very sexy -- but -- there's a lot of it out there.
REX Seems like there's more of it than ever before --

value.name: Miles probes wife's legal position
value.description: Miles shifts from banter to legal strategy by asking whether Marylin has pursued opportunities or retained counsel.
evidence: MILES Well, with the expanding global population -- Let me ask you this -- your wife. Has she pursued the opportunities which must present themselves to the "knock-out, sexy woman" you described?
MILES Not in court you can't. Has she retained counsel?

value.name: Rex reveals wife has video evidence
value.description: Rex admits that Marylin has video evidence of his activities, raising the stakes of the divorce case.
evidence: REX I don't know. I can assume...
MILES And your wife is aware of or has evidence of your activities?
REX Video.

value.name: Miles asks about prenuptial agreement
value.description: Miles presses for the final key fact in the divorce case by asking whether there is a prenuptial agreement.
evidence: MILES Mmm... And to cut to the chase, forensically speaking -- is there a pre-nup?

value.name: Rex realizes bad divorce position
value.description: Rex hangs his head, signaling that the prenuptial question has exposed his unfavorable legal situation.
evidence: Rex hangs his head.
Miles sighs sympathetic
